skills.description:
You have a product people like but revenue isn't growing. Should you go PLG? Hire sales? Raise prices? This helps you diagnose whether you have a distribution problem, a pricing problem, or a PMF problem — then gives you the playbook for each.

What's inside:
• PMF validation framework ("40% very disappointed" test + signal detection)
• PLG freemium → paid funnel design (activation, expansion, conversion)
• SLG enterprise sales motion (LinkedIn DM at 10-15% reply rate)
• Pricing & packaging strategy (value metric, tier design, willingness-to-pay)
• Channel partnerships & affiliate marketing systems

Built from: Frameworks from HeyGen, Deel, Vercel, Supabase, AWS. Kuse: 60 days → $10M ARR.
